description: Monitoring and tracking tool for Plex Media Server.

promotion.reason: Qualified on 2026-09-10 and approved by the owner. A real install proved it starts, opens to a usable screen, survives a restart and a keep-data reinstall with its data intact, and removes everything it created. 2.18.1 is upstream's current release, published 2026-08-27, and this image was rebuilt 2026-09-04 for amd64 and arm64. Re-run against Runtipi's definition after CapRover's turned out to pin 2.7.5 from 2021.

risk_notes: Creates 1 Docker container and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.
Keeps its data in this app's managed folder. A keep-data uninstall leaves it; deleting data removes it permanently.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.

Watches a Plex Media Server you already run, and does nothing useful without one. It opens to a setup wizard that asks for that server, and has no sign-in of its own until you turn one on in that wizard.
